title: health-misinfo-context: code and derived tables for a comparison of CoAID and FakeHealth
description: Code, saved splits, model locks, classical model bundles, aggregate tables, bootstrap draws and item-level predictions behind the preprint 'Fake–Real gaps in observed spread and detectability differ between health misinformation datasets built in different ways: a comparison of CoAID and FakeHealth'. Source datasets (CoAID, FakeHealth, the COVID-19 Rumor Dataset and FakeNewsNet) are not redistributed. See README.md and REPRODUCING.md.

creators.name: Valdiviezo, Jesús
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Princeton University
